summary_en: This Phase 2 study tests whether dosing lutetium Lu 177 dotatate (Lutathera) based on individualized dosimetry improves treatment outcomes compared with standard dosing, in adults with unresectable neuroendocrine tumors. The drug is given into a vein once every 8 weeks for up to 4 cycles, with cycle 1 at 200 mCi and later cycles based on radiation dosimetry, and participants are randomized to standard or individualized dosing. The main outcome is not stated in the record; the study is listed as Phase 2.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 busca saber si dosificar lutetium Lu 177 dotatate (Lutathera) según dosimetría individualizada mejora los resultados del tratamiento en comparación con la dosis estándar, en adultos con tumores neuroendocrinos no resecables. El medicamento se administra por vena cada 8 semanas, hasta 4 ciclos; el ciclo 1 es de 200 mCi y los siguientes se basan en la dosimetría de radiación, y los participantes son asignados al azar a dosis estándar o individualizada. El resultado principal no está indicado en el registro; el estudio aparece como fase 2.
who_for: Adults aged 18 or older who signed informed consent
Well-differentiated neuroendocrine tumor with Ki-67 of 20% or less, believed to be gastroenteropancreatic origin
Disease at least 1.5 cm on CT or MRI with SSTR2 PET uptake above liver background, scan within 90 days
Recommended Lutathera for unresectable or metastatic neuroendocrine disease
ECOG 0 or 1, or Karnofsky of 70 or higher, with normal neutrophil and platelet counts within 28 days
not_for: Prior external beam kidney radiation dose above 10 Gy
Uncontrolled illness, including active infection or unstable heart conditions
Surgery, radiation, or chemotherapy within 4 weeks, or allergy to similar compounds to Octreoscan or Netspot
